text: Two circles of radius $5$ are externally tangent to each other and are internally tangent to a circle of radius $13$ at points $A$ and $B$, as shown in the diagram. The distance $AB$ can be written in the form $\frac{m}{n}$, where $m$ and $n$ are relatively prime positive integers. What is $m+n$?
figure: A large circle of radius 13. Inside it, in the lower part, two equal circles of radius 5 sit side by side and touch each other at one point. The left small circle touches the large circle from inside at point A (lower left), and the right small circle touches the large circle from inside at point B (lower right). Only A and B are labeled; no centers or segments are drawn.
